action.mutates: starts a transient unit p8test-listener (python3 -m http.server 8888 on 0.0.0.0) on the node
three connection attempts from the peer to the class node (ICMP, TCP 22, TCP 8888); results in /run/p8test-firewall/reach.txt on the peer

after 61 s (the 60 s recent window of the previous check expires and the limit refills), 20 parallel TCP connects from the peer to the class node's port 22; counts in /run/p8test-firewall/burst.txt on the peer

adds a second address (its host-only address + 100, /24) to the peer's host-only NIC, then 20 parallel TCP connects from it to the class node's port 22; counts in /run/p8test-firewall/whitelisted.txt on the peer

after 61 s (the earlier burst's 60 s recent window expires), 10 SSH connections from the peer's primary address to the class node, one every 4 s, each held open for 50 s; the established count goes to /run/p8test-firewall/held.txt on the peer

after 61 s (the held connections' window expires), 18 TCP connects from the peer's primary address to the class node's port 22, one every 3.5 s; the sequence goes to /run/p8test-firewall/spaced.txt on the peer
appends `-A INPUT -s 10.255.255.1/32 -m comment --comment p8test-rogue -j ACCEPT` on the node
none beyond reading the rules (declared mutating so it runs after the node's agent run)
